name: Art Deco Gold
summary: A 1920s grand lobby: onyx, emerald and midnight marble inlaid with metallic gold sunbursts, chevrons, fans and stepped corners.
description: The world is one endless grand floor of 200-unit marble bays – sunburst medallions, harlequin diamonds, fan scallops, zigzag chevrons, reflecting pools and parterre gardens – separated by midnight-blue terrazzo promenades with bevelled gold borders and compass rosettes. Everything is strict geometry in a tight palette of deep black, emerald and midnight blue with metallic gold and ivory; gold is always drawn as a banded linear gradient or a dark / mid / bright bevel stroke so it reads as polished metal. Figures are elegant geometric cut-outs with a thin ink outline and a gilded rim: a dapper gentleman in an ivory dinner jacket and top hat, enamel scarabs carrying sun discs, swept-wing swifts and a gilded guardian statue with a fan headdress.
bestFor: stylish top-down action and arcade projects
heist, casino, hotel or jazz-age settings
elegant menus, title screens and card UIs
art-deco inspired city builders and museums

difficulty.why: Every asset is plain geometry – polygons, arcs, stepped rectangles and radial fans – so new pieces come together quickly from a small vocabulary, and the metallic look is a reusable gradient plus a three-pass bevel stroke. The craft is restraint: keeping the floor calm enough behind the actors, keeping symmetry and the pin-line rhythm consistent, and giving every new figure a clear silhouette against the dark ground (the gilded rim does most of that work).

technique.renderer: Canvas 2D (procedural, no image assets): vector parts baked into sprites at init, world-anchored marble and terrazzo patterns for the floor
technique.resolution: Native resolution. Sprites are baked at K = clamp(round(screenHeight/360 * 1.7), 3, 7) px per world unit (4 px/unit at 900 px); the floor is baked in 256-unit chunks at up to 2.5 px/unit (groundResMax 2.5).
technique.summary: Shapes are hard-edged polygons, arcs and stepped rectangles filled with linear gradients; gold is a six-stop banded metal gradient, gold lines are stroked three times (dark edge, mid gold, thin bright highlight). The floor is drawn per chunk with patterns made from baked tileable marble and terrazzo textures, so every inlay stays continuous across chunks.
technique.linework: Figures: an ink outline #07080b of 0.5-0.8 units made by dilating the silhouette, plus a gilded rim #c9973a 0.42 units outside it. Floor and props: no outline; gold pin-lines of 0.4-0.6 units (#c99a3c) and bevelled gold bands of 1.0-1.3 units (dark #5a3d10 at 1.55x, mid #b8862f at 1x, highlight #fff0b8 at 0.34x). Miter joins, butt caps, everything straight or circular.
technique.shading: Linear gradients only, lit from the upper left: ivory #fffaf0 -> #cdbb93, enamel light/base/dark (jade #6fd8b8 / #1f9a80 / #0a4a40), black satin #26272f -> #0b0c10. Gold fill = banded gradient #fff0b8, #e9bf5c, #9a6c22, #c8973a, #f5d98a, #7d561a. Gold rings use a radial gradient across the ring width so they look turned and polished.
technique.lighting: A warm light from above (radial rgba(255,214,140,.13) from above the top edge) with 28 faint sunburst rays, a strong dark vignette rgba(4,5,9,.66), additive warm glows only on lamp lanterns, the orbiting sun discs, the large collectible and the guardian's jade eyes.
technique.texture: Marble: 192 px tileable textures from periodic sine veins warped by tileable fbm (onyx, emerald, midnight, ivory), used as patterns at 0.5-0.62 units per texel with a random 90° rotation and offset per bay. Terrazzo: a 160 px midnight base with 1100 chips in ivory, gold, jade, black and blue. A 30 % dark varnish over every bay keeps the floor below the actors.

paletteRules: Dark surfaces (onyx, midnight, emerald) take about 80 % of the screen; gold is only ever lines, rims, bands, discs and small ornaments – never a large flat field.
Gold is always metal: a banded gradient for fills, three stacked strokes (dark, mid, highlight) for lines, a radial gradient for rings. Never a flat yellow.
Ivory is the bright accent and the main character's colour; keep large ivory areas off the floor (only medallion centres and pool coping).
Creatures are enamel (jade, lapis, onyx) or pearl and gold – one enamel colour per figure plus gold trim.
Ruby is the only warm colour besides gold and appears only in small doses (bars, the heart icon, hurt flashes).
No pastels, no gradients between unrelated hues, no pure white except tiny sparkle cores.

world.summary: One endless grand floor laid out on a strict 200-unit grid: each square bay is a framed marble inlay of a different type, separated by 28-unit midnight terrazzo promenades with bevelled gold borders, ivory lozenge studs and gold compass rosettes at every crossing.
layers: Base fill: onyx marble pattern over the whole chunk (groundColor #0d0e12)

Bays (interior 172 units): stepped-corner frame (two 7-unit notches per corner), bevelled gold band 1.25 units at 2.4 inset, 0.45 pin-line at 7 inset; type from a hash: 25 % medallion, 17 % harlequin, 15 % scallop, 13 % pool, 17 % garden, 13 % chevron

Medallion: a 58-unit sunburst in one of three designed variants picked per bay (16 emerald rays + 8-point star; 12 wide midnight-glass rays + 12-point star, turned half a ray; 24 fine emerald rays + 6-point star), gold pin-lines between the rays, a gilded rim with a ring of 32 gold beads, an ivory centre disc with a gold star, and four corner fans of six alternating segments - so neighbouring medallion bays never read as one stamp
Harlequin: emerald field with onyx diamonds (half-diagonal 12), gold pin-lines along both diagonal lattices, ivory studs at every vertex
Scallop: overlapping fish-scale fans r 12 in rows 11 units apart, rows alternate jade and lapis gradients, each with a gold arc, inner arc, five short rays and a small gold half-sun
Chevron: zigzag bands 13 units tall (period 26, amplitude 6.5) cycling onyx / emerald / onyx / midnight with gold seams, a stepped ivory-and-onyx diamond inlay with a 4-point star in the centre
Pool: ivory marble coping 10 units, water with a diagonal gradient #1a4b6b -> #0a2136, concentric ripple rings every 9 units, zigzag wavelets in the corners, a faint diagonal sheen
Garden: hedge border #082219, striped lawn #0f3a2b / #123f2f, four stepped parterre beds with dotted planting rays, terrazzo cross paths and a round basin with an emerald star

Value hierarchy: a varnish over each bay - 44 % rgba(4,5,9) over the busy all-over patterns (harlequin, scallop, chevron), 30 % over the focal bays (medallion, pool, garden) - so the promenades frame them, the eye goes to the medallions and the actors stay the clearest read

Promenades: calm terrazzo pattern (560 chips per 160-px tile, deliberately sparse), bevelled gold borders at ±12.4, pin-lines at ±9.6, ivory lozenge studs every 20 units on the centre line; crossings get a gold-framed square with a gold 8-point compass star on an onyx disc

characters.summary: Elegant geometric figures in 3/4 view baked into sprites with an ink outline and a thin gilded rim. The main character (~31 x 42 units with the hat) is a dapper gentleman: an ivory dinner jacket with squared shoulders and a pointed cutaway hem trimmed in gold, black satin lapels, a bow tie with a gold knot, a gold fan pocket square, black trousers, ivory spats, a champagne face with a slicked black hairline and a thin moustache, a black top hat with a gold band, and a black cane with a gold knob. Creatures: an enamel scarab (small; jade, lapis or onyx shell engraved with a gold sunburst, carrying a gold sun disc), a swift seen from above (fast; pearl swept wings with jade and gold chevrons, a jade body, a gold forked tail) and a gilded guardian statue (large, ~42 x 64 units) with a gold mask, glowing jade eye slits, a fan headdress, a stepped bronze torso with gold chevrons and a sun medallion.
rules: Build from hard geometry: trapezoid torsos, squared shoulders, stepped (ziggurat) silhouettes, half-disc fans and circles – no blobby or organic curves except the scarab shell and swift wings.
Every figure gets the same outline recipe: dilated ink silhouette (0.5-0.8 units) plus a gold rim 0.42 units outside it – that rim is what makes dark parts readable on the dark floor.
One enamel colour per creature plus gold trim; the main character is the only ivory-jacketed figure.

Main character: 6 walk frames (scissor legs ±0.44 rad, foot lift 1.5, opposite arm swing, cane swing) plus three idle poses - standing, eyes closed (blink) and a cane tap with the arm lifted - so the idle has life without moving the feet.

Scarab: 4-frame tripod leg gait, 0.5-unit bob; swift: 4 wing-span frames (1, 0.72, 0.38, 0.72) at 12 per second, hovering 13 units above its shadow and rotated to its flight direction; guardian: 4 heavy stepping frames with a 0.8-unit body bob.

Appearing: a gold sunburst ring opens on the floor; ground creatures then rise out of it - revealed bottom-up as a gold silhouette behind a bright 0.7-unit reveal line while lifting 5 units, then switch to enamel with a decaying squash (8 %) as the gold fades; the swift drops in from 26 units above.

Hit flash: a warm ivory #fff6dc silhouette over the sprite, a small squash and a 0.2 rad tilt away from the push. Vanishing (0.35 s): 18 % ivory flash over the gold silhouette as it swells 6 %, then the gilded figure splits into 6 stepped horizontal bands (9 for the large figure) that slide apart alternately left and right with an ease-out, drop and fade from the top band down, while gold leaf and enamel chips scatter.

props.summary: Symmetric Deco furniture placed by the bay layout, not at random: gilded sun-bearer statues on stepped onyx plinths and tiered ivory fountains at medallion and pool centres, segmented palms in stepped planters on garden parterres, stepped cypress topiaries in ivory cubes, fan-leaf plants in chevron vases, and four streamlined lamp posts with glowing stepped glass lanterns around every other crossing.
rules: Props sit on the grid: centres, parterre centres, stepped corners and crossings – symmetry is part of the style.
Every plinth, planter and base is stepped (two or three tiers) with a gold band on each step.
Lamp: onyx pillar with gold rings and fluting, a three-tier ziggurat lantern of glowing ivory glass with gold mullions and an additive warm glow that flickers ±6 %.
Fountain: octagonal ivory basin seen in 3/4 view, a fluted column, a scallop-shell bowl and fan-shaped water arcs drawn per frame as dashed pale-teal strokes with a moving dash offset.
Plants are geometric: palm fronds are straight-edged lozenges with gold midribs, fan leaves are 9 pleated wedges, topiaries are stacked emerald tiers with chevron shading.
Props get a thin ink outline (0.6 units) but no gold rim, and a soft radial contact shadow; tall props turn 55 % translucent when the main character walks behind them.

effects.name: Gold dart projectile
effects.how: A slim gold lozenge (banded gradient, bright centre line) rotated to its flight angle with three parallel pin-line streaks fading behind it and a small additive warm glow.

effects.name: Orbiting sun disc
effects.how: A gold disc with 12 alternating long and short rays and a glowing ivory core, spinning at 2.2 rad/s over an additive glow and a soft ground shadow.

effects.name: Collectibles
effects.how: Small: an emerald step-cut gem (octagon with two inner facet rings) in a gold bezel that turns by squeezing its width. Large: an Asscher-cut ivory diamond with gold prongs, a warm glow and a twinkling 4-point glint.

effects.name: Sunburst flash
effects.how: Radiating gold lines (8-28, alternate long and short) that expand from the impact point and fade, drawn additively; flattened to an ellipse when it lies on the floor.

effects.name: Gold leaf burst
effects.how: When a creature vanishes: 8-16 gold leaf flakes flip between a bright gradient front and a dark gold back (horizontal scale |cos|), float on light gravity and high drag, joined by enamel shards in the creature's colour, a double gold floor ring and glints.

effects.name: Impact
effects.how: A 4-point ivory-gold glint plus a short 10-ray sunburst at hit height and a couple of gold leaf flakes.

effects.name: Glow-up
effects.how: A big double gold ring on the floor, a flat 28-ray sunburst, a second upright burst, 20 gold leaves and 8 glints; a rotating sunburst halo of 18 rays shines behind the main character.

effects.name: Floating numbers
effects.how: Limelight in ivory #f6ecd2 with an ink stroke; emphasised values are larger, filled with the gold gradient and sit on a small ring of gold rays.

atmosphere.summary: A night-time grand lobby under warm light: a soft golden glow and faint sunburst rays from above the top edge, a deep dark vignette, glowing lanterns, drifting gold dust motes and a gold double pin-line frame with stepped corners and corner fans around the screen.
rules: Screen overlay baked once per size: radial warm light rgba(255,214,140,.13) from above the top centre, 28 additive sunburst rays at 7 % alpha, vignette to rgba(4,5,9,.66).
Frame: stepped gold double pin-line 7 units from the edge (1.0 + 0.45 units, 75 % alpha) with quarter sunburst fans in the four corners.
Ambient life: one gold dust mote on half the cells of a 95-unit grid, drifting upward and twinkling, drawn additively at 15-75 % alpha.
Shadows: soft radial black ellipses (alpha .6 core) under every figure and prop; flying figures keep a lighter shadow below them.
Glow is reserved for light sources and treasure: lanterns, sun discs, the large collectible, the guardian's eyes – everything else is matte or polished, never neon.
Modal overlays: dark radial backdrop with a fine repeating conic sunburst of gold rays at 6.5 % alpha.

ui.summary: Deco frames everywhere: panels have notched two-step corners (clip-path) with a gold double border drawn by an SVG border-image (metallic outer line, thin inner pin-line, tiny gold diamonds), on a midnight-to-onyx gradient. Bars are black channels with a gold pin border and fluted fills (gold, or ruby for the panel bar). The title is huge Limelight capitals in a gold gradient flanked by double pin-lines; cards carry a sunburst header of gold rays, a circular icon well with a double gold ring and a gold diamond number badge on the top edge.

motion: Main character: 6 walk frames over 5.6 animation units per cycle with a |sin| bob of 0.9 units and a 0.03 rad lean; idle breathing ±1.2 % vertical at 2.2 rad/s, a cane tap every 4.3 s (0.39 s, rising 0.4 units on the toes) and a blink every 3.2 s (0.13 s).

Dash: a 35 ms crouch (y -10 %, x +7 %) as anticipation, then the figure leans 0.16 rad, three gold silhouettes trail 7 units apart at alpha 0.42/i and three parallel gold speed lines stream behind. Hurt: 0.16 rad recoil with the ivory flash.
Scarab: tripod gait at anim*0.9*4 frames; swift: wing frames at 12 per second, hover bob ±1.6 units, nose follows the flight direction; guardian: 4 frames at anim*1.2 with a ±0.02 rad sway.

Appear 0.45 s: the floor sigil (ellipse + 12 rays) grows with outQuad and fades on a sine; the figure rises out of it from 20 % to 80 % (bottom-up reveal, ease-out cubic) and settles over the last 20 %. Vanish 0.35 s: flash and gilding for 18 %, then the stepped bands slide out (spread 8 units, 12 for the large figure) and fall with u².
Sunburst flashes expand with outQuad and fade linearly in 0.2-0.7 s; gold leaf flips at 10 rad/s and lives about a second.
Lantern glow flickers ±6 % at 5 rad/s; fountain dashes flow at 9 units/s; pool ripples expand every ~8 s; gold motes rise 4 units/s.
HUD: cards and title rise 24 px and fade in over 0.5 s (staggered 0.08 s); a card lifts 8 px and brightens on hover.
do: Draw every gold element as metal: banded gradient fills, three-pass bevel strokes, radial-gradient rings.
Keep the composition symmetric and on a grid – bays, props and ornaments are centred or mirrored.
Use stepped (ziggurat) corners on frames, plinths, planters, panels and cards.
Repeat the core motifs: sunbursts, fans, chevrons, concentric arcs and parallel pin-lines.
Darken the floor fields (varnish) so ivory figures and gold rims read first.
Give every figure the ink outline plus gilded rim so black parts never vanish on the dark floor.
Set titles in wide-spaced capitals and keep body text small and quiet.
Make vanishing and appearing geometric: split figures into stepped bands, reveal them from the floor sigil upwards - never a plain fade.
dont: Don't use flat yellow for gold or let gold fill large areas – it turns brassy and loud.
Don't use soft organic blobs, hand-drawn wobble or textured brush strokes – every edge is ruled or compass-drawn.
Don't introduce pastels or extra hues; the palette is black, emerald, midnight, gold, ivory and a touch of ruby.
Don't scatter props randomly – random placement breaks the Deco order.
Don't use lead-came borders around every shape (that reads as stained glass) or gothic pointed arches.
Don't add neon glows or bloom to ordinary surfaces.
Don't make the floor brighter than the figures.
Don't repeat one medallion as a stamp; vary rays, star points and glass per bay and let the busy patterns sit back.
performance: Baked once at init (~150-250 ms): five floor textures (four 192/160 px marble textures from tileable fbm veins, one terrazzo), the main character in 9 poses, 12 scarab, 4 swift and 4 guardian sprites, each with an ivory flash and a gold silhouette copy, 6 props, effect sprites and glow gradients. Per frame there are only drawImage blits with a setTransform, a few gold strokes (fountain arcs, speed lines, sunburst rays) and one cached full-screen overlay: about 2 ms median for a full scene with 50-100 creatures, cheaper than most styles. Floor chunks (256 units, up to 640 px) are drawn by a generator yielding after every bay (2-4 ms each); the scallop bay with ~120 gradient circles is the most expensive. Appearing and vanishing figures are drawn from row ranges of the already baked gold silhouette (drawImage source rectangles), so they cost 1-9 blits and no extra canvases.
